source.source_name: CNMV — financial reports of listed/issuer companies (XBRL)
source.organization: Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV)
source.attribution: Source: Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores (CNMV).

access.note: Open and free. Scope limited to entities with securities admitted to trading.

pagination.note: Enumerate issuers/reports via the IPP listing (cnmv.es/ipps) or datos.gob.es CNMV datasets, then download each XBRL+PDF. Confirm exact listing endpoint from the live portal.

parsing.notes: Parse XBRL with Arelle against the CNMV/IPP taxonomy. Capture consolidated vs individual. Map Importe neto de la cifra de negocios -> revenue, Resultado del ejercicio -> net_result, Total activo -> total_assets, Patrimonio neto -> equity.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per ejercicio x report type (IFA/IFI); prefer IFA for annual.
mapping_rules.revenue: Importe neto de la cifra de negocios
mapping_rules.matching: Join to the company spine via NIF/CIF.

fixture_requirements: annual (IFA) XBRL with full balance + P&L
consolidated vs individual report for the same issuer
issuer matched to a CIF on the spine

live_test_plan.smoke: Pull one issuer's latest IFA XBRL from cnmv.es/ipps; parse total_assets/revenue/net_result; assert NIF present.
live_test_plan.full: Enumerate issuers via the IPP listing / datos.gob.es; download XBRL+PDF per issuer/period behind an env gate; parse and normalize.

blockers: Scope limited to listed issuers — not the general company population.
Exact machine listing endpoint for enumerating reports to confirm from the live portal.
